verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's docs describe context-aware review that learns from feedback, prioritizes PRs by value/risk, and offers granular auto-review controls to limit noise (docs-1, docs-3, docs-21), but there is no explicit documentation of comment deduplication or severity labels, and hands-on community reports directly contradict the low-noise claim ('too verbose, catching too many false positives... removed it' — comm-2) even as other users praise its accuracy (comm-1, comm-6, comm-7). Missing for 10: documented deduplication mechanism, explicit severity-label feature, and independent confirmation that false-positive rates are actually low.
